neighbours.label: the word right after stopping or pausing that names what the pause is for ('stop to think', 'stopped to look', 'paused for effect'): interrupting one activity to attend to something
fire: On the way to work she stopped to buy flowers for her mother.
Nobody ever stops to ask why the bus is always late on Mondays.
The hikers stopped to rest on a flat rock above the waterfall.
Before answering, the senator paused for a moment and smiled.
Have you ever stopped to wonder where your recycling actually goes?
Halfway up the hill we stopped to catch our breath and drink water.
The busy chef rarely stops to taste the soup before it goes out.
My grandfather would always pause to admire a well-built stone wall.
quiet: On the way to work she wanted to buy flowers for her mother.
Nobody ever bothers asking why the bus is always late on Mondays.
The hikers decided to camp on a flat rock above the waterfall.
Before answering, the senator looked at his notes and smiled.
Have you ever tried to find out where your recycling actually goes?
Halfway up the hill we began to sing and drink water.
The busy chef rarely forgets to salt the soup before it goes out.
My grandfather would always hope to build a well-made stone wall.
